caption: The drawing depicts two cylindrical objects positioned vertically and parallel to each other within a narrow rectangular border. Both objects are segmented into sections, with alternating light brown, dark brown, and beige hues, creating a striped effect along their lengths. The object on the left features a rounded top with an ornate, gray, leaf-patterned carved section below it, and the bottom of this object has a slightly flared, shaped end. The object on the right is longer, with a flat, dark crown-like top and a straight shaft. This shaft contains multiple segments, some with intricate patterns or darker bands. The lower section of the right object appears to taper slightly and is a lighter brown color with some carved or etched designs near the base. Both objects are rendered with careful attention to texture and color variation. The background is plain and off-white, and fine pencil labels are faintly visible at the bottom, including the phrases "Entire Length 33¾," "Sections Full Size," and "Manihiki Mace."
title: Cowhorn Cane
